entities.summary: Karetus is a Portuguese electronic music duo formed in 2010 by DJs and record producers Carlos Silva and André Reis. Originally emerging from the Lisbon area, the project quickly became known for a high-energy blend of bass-driven electronic music and references to Portuguese popular culture, as well as for a visually striking live show built around masks inspired by the traditional caretos of north-eastern Portugal.
